### DT Midstream to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results, Schedules Earnings Call


10/15/2026


DETROIT, Oct. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- DT Midstream, Inc. (NYSE: DTM) plans to announce third quarter 2026 financial results before the market opens on Thursday, October 29, 2026.


DT Midstream has scheduled a conference call to discuss results for 9:00 a.m. ET (8:00 a.m. CT) the same day. Investors, the news media and the public may listen to a live internet broadcast of the call at this[link](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=v8_dtb39lUrdu9k3hJszx3m8lq-Vo7YfCUoZIINkRqn5p_dE0GzfH6wwYXiq2HNiEsH1oruVWgax-SuOBYKTcDL679-gXKKxF6wGoeagnRo=) . The participant toll-free telephone dial-in number in the U.S. and Canada is 833.461.5787, and the toll number is 585.542.9983; the conference ID is 362887253. International access numbers are available[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=DldEx4EtZW7-3qW6HXWcTlUk4NK4chLDTU6KD5ve_3qdafCMfzFN1ipxLNwyDwfZxzwBRoAi15v30bu3qXUH7hxisFj8E2Y62ABlrQcpjE55416Jpm8RjmNGOMDBL1vw) .


The webcast will be archived on the DT Midstream website at[investor.dtmidstream.com](http://investor.dtmidstream.com/) .


**About DT Midstream**


DT Midstream (NYSE: DTM) is an owner, operator and developer of natural gas interstate and intrastate pipelines, storage and gathering systems, compression, treatment and surface facilities. The company transports clean natural gas for utilities, power plants, marketers, large industrial customers and energy producers across the Southern, Northeastern and Midwestern United States and Canada. The Detroit-based company offers a comprehensive, wellhead-to-market array of services, including natural gas transportation, storage and gathering. For more information, please visit the DT Midstream website at www.dtmidstream.com.
